config.buffer_geometry: fixed compile-time constant (NWORDS=4096); identical to src/leakage_demo.cu baseline
config.co_residency_method: single-block, same-SM forced via __launch_bounds__(32,1); %smid verified per trial

smid_note: %smid is a documented PTX special register (PTX ISA §9.4); reading it slightly perturbs scheduling

residue_run.description: writer without scrub then listener; measures raw cross-launch EI

control_run.description: listener only, writer never launched; validity gate run FIRST before any writer (must be 0.0)

lmhc_scrub_run.description: writer with LMHC hardened scrub (volatile + __threadfence_block() + __syncthreads()) then listener

framing: Residue is fully observable when the subsequent kernel is co-resident on the same SM -- co-residency is forced in this experiment to demonstrate the window. This is in-process cross-kernel shared-memory persistence, NOT cross-tenant LeftoverLocals on NVIDIA. Co-residency is forced on every device, so these are controlled-placement results consistent with our adversarial threat model -- not natural-scheduling frequencies, and not a claim about production prevalence or about non-tested hardware.
result_summary: VALID: control clean; LMHC scrub drives EI to 0.0 on this device.
